name: Toolboxes
summary: ToolboxSearchPreviewTool attached to a Prompt Agent whose orchestrator model is BYOM-routed.
description: Foundry Toolboxes let you register a reusable bundle of tools (e.g. MCP servers) and hand an agent a `toolbox_search_preview` tool so it can discover them at runtime. Verified live 2026-07-15: creating a toolbox with an MCP tool works, but attaching `ToolboxSearchPreviewTool` to a BYOM-prefixed Prompt Agent is rejected by the Foundry Responses API with a 400.
notes: Server error verbatim: 'The following tools are not supported with BYO model: toolbox_search_preview. Please remove these tools or use a standard model deployment.' Toolbox itself provisions fine; the block is at agent-invocation time on any BYOM-prefixed model.
